paths.description: Homepage/auto-located forecast entry and initial consent state; represents acquisition and city discovery.
Kyiv seven-day detail, the core forecast template and primary task.
Long-range forecast variant and period-navigation destination.
Support feedback form, representing the primary authored form plus consent decision.
Long-form legal/content template used to inspect reading chrome and orientation.
Invalid route used to inspect not-found recovery behavior.

findings.summary: No user-preference dark theme
findings.evidence: The dark and default screenshots are byte-identical (91,884 bytes), and the computed root color-scheme is "normal".
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and theme surfaces through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Contrast preferences and minimum contrast are not fully supported
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast screenshot is unchanged, while Lighthouse fails color-contrast.
findings.suggestedFix: Use system colors/forced-colors support and ensure WCAG contrast in the normal palette.

findings.summary: Route and forecast-state changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS inspection found no view-transition declarations for navigation between forecast views.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document or cross-document View Transitions with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not reflect scroll position
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no scroll-state container query or progress indicator on long forecast/legal pages.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress affordance where it helps orientation.

findings.summary: Navigation changes provide no attention cue
findings.evidence: Forecast-day and 10-day navigation use ordinary abrupt link swaps with no transition/highlight cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve and visibly cue the selected forecast period and transition direction.

findings.summary: Consent interstitial obscures the entire primary forecast
findings.evidence: Load screenshots show a full modal and dimmed page before any user action; on 360px it is clipped off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a compact, immediately dismissible consent surface with an equally prominent reject choice.

findings.summary: Consent UI is implemented as custom dialog divs
findings.evidence: DOM probe reports four DIV role=dialog surfaces, no dialog elements, no popovers, and no aria-modal.
findings.suggestedFix: Use dialog/popover semantics, focus management, Escape handling, and declarative dismissal.

findings.summary: Advertising and consent chrome dominate content
findings.evidence: The first viewport is entirely consent chrome; HAR shows most transferred script bytes come from advertising/analytics.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce non-content chrome and defer advertising until after the forecast is usable.

findings.summary: Forecast pages force a desktop-width canvas on mobile
findings.evidence: At a 360px viewport, layout reports scrollWidth/innerWidth 1010px and 650px overflow; the consent panel is clipped.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a device-width layout with intrinsic sizing, wrapping forecast rows, and no fixed 1010px minimum.

findings.summary: Forecast components do not adapt to their containers
findings.evidence: The computed CSS probe found zero container rules; reused forecast cards retain fixed desktop sizing at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt container queries for forecast grids/cards that appear in different available widths.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and several targets are too small
findings.evidence: The focus probe reports outline style none for sampled links, inputs, and buttons; many links are only 14px high and buttons 17-28px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide visible :focus-visible styles and at least 24px, preferably 44px, pointer target areas.

findings.summary: Consent wall blocks the core weather task on entry
findings.evidence: All primary-path screenshots open behind a full consent wall naming 234 partners; the forecast cannot be read until it is handled.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep core forecast content available while presenting a proportionate consent decision with accept and reject.

findings.summary: Throttled LCP is far outside the good range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports LCP 9.5s, TBT 218.5ms, performance 0.70; desktop layout independently observed CLS 0.119.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP forecast content and delay consent/ad/analytics work.

findings.summary: Late content causes visible layout instability
findings.evidence: The layout primitive recorded CLS 0.1193 on the Kyiv page, including an initial 0.1126 shift; images lack dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for images, ads, fonts, and consent content before they load.

findings.summary: Main-thread work misses the interaction budget under throttling
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 218.5ms TBT and forced-reflow insight failure; 13 scripts are loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and schedule work, remove forced synchronous layout, and defer nonessential scripts.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is burdened by fonts and third parties
findings.evidence: HAR captures 87 requests/1.43MB, including 1.03MB script and 175KB fonts; Lighthouse flags render blocking, font display, caching, and dependency-tree insights.
findings.suggestedFix: Self-host/subset fonts, shorten critical chains, cache well, and defer ad/analytics resources.

findings.summary: Large unused JavaScript is shipped
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 367KiB unused JavaScript and 24KiB unused CSS; HAR shows duplicate Google tag payloads near 157KB each.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicate tags and conditionally load advertising/analytics and route-specific code.

findings.summary: Interactive ARIA semantics are invalid or unnamed
findings.evidence: Lighthouse fails button-name, aria-prohibited-attr, aria-required-children, aria-required-parent, and label-content-name-mismatch.
findings.suggestedFix: Use native elements and correct accessible names/role relationships, then retest the accessibility tree.

findings.summary: Text and UI fail minimum contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse explicitly fails the color-contrast audit on the representative forecast page.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens to meet WCAG AA in all states.

findings.summary: Focus visibility and heading structure are compromised
findings.evidence: All sampled interactive elements compute outline:none; the consent DOM injects hundreds of H2s and several H1s into the page hierarchy.
findings.suggestedFix: Restore visible focus and isolate dialog headings while keeping one logical page H1.

findings.summary: Mobile forecast text is scaled and clipped instead of reflowed
findings.evidence: At 360px the page lays out at 1010px; the screenshot exposes only a narrow slice and many links compute to 14px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow forecast content at narrow widths and preserve comfortable readable text sizing.

findings.summary: Reflow and target sizing fail on mobile
findings.evidence: Mobile layout has 650px horizontal overflow, while focus probe shows multiple controls below 24px tall.
findings.suggestedFix: Support 320/360px reflow and enlarge interactive hit areas without preventing zoom.

findings.summary: Images omit intrinsic dimensions
findings.evidence: Images primitive finds all three images without width/height attributes; one below-fold image is not lazy and one PNG lacks a responsive source.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio, lazy-load below-fold media, and provide responsive modern sources.

findings.summary: The page is not eligible for back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports three BFCache failure reasons.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable unload/runtime blockers and verify restoration in the BFCache diagnostics.

findings.summary: CSP is missing and multiple cookies are not Secure
findings.evidence: Headers primitive finds no CSP; cookies primitive reports six cookies without Secure and several SameSite=None, long-lived cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and set Secure/SameSite/expiry according to cookie purpose.

findings.summary: Tracking footprint is disproportionate to a weather lookup
findings.evidence: Trackers primitive finds 20 third-party origins and three known trackers; consent names 234 partners and HAR records 38 XHR/fetch requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors, gate tracking on consent, and batch only essential analytics.

findings.summary: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent
findings.evidence: Headers primitive confirms HSTS, nosniff, and X-Frame-Options, but finds no CSP, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Add least-privilege Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy alongside CSP.

findings.summary: Consent dialog is cut off at narrow viewports
findings.evidence: The 360x800 screenshot shows only the right portion of the consent panel and action area because the document remains 1010px wide.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the modal fit the visual viewport with internal scrolling and resilient focus/dismiss behavior.

findings.summary: Layout is not writing-mode resilient
findings.evidence: The page correctly sets lang=uk and exposes uk/ru-UA hreflang, but CSS inspection counts 121 physical left/right rules and the root has no explicit dir.
findings.suggestedFix: Set dir and migrate layout-critical spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Consent choice is asymmetric and vendor-heavy
findings.evidence: The opening dialog prominently offers Settings and Agree, with no equally visible Reject action, while stating 234 partners may process data.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer honest defaults and equally prominent accept/reject controls without obstructing the forecast.

findings.summary: Feedback form gives no pre-submit explanation for a disabled action
findings.evidence: Email and message fields are not required in markup and the submit button starts disabled; the initial DOM exposes no error/help association or live status.
findings.suggestedFix: Use required/input constraints, validate after interaction, and announce specific errors with aria-describedby/live regions.

findings.summary: Email input omits autocomplete
findings.evidence: Feedback probe finds inputmode=email but an empty autocomplete token on the response email field.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type=email and autocomplete=email to assist entry and validation.

findings.summary: Asset delivery misses basic image optimisations
findings.evidence: Images primitive reports three missing intrinsic dimensions, one non-lazy below-fold image, a legacy PNG, and a missing responsive source.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve appropriately sized modern images with dimensions, srcset, and lazy loading.

findings.summary: Advertising and analytics create substantial background work
findings.evidence: HAR records 87 requests including 38 XHR/fetch and 1.03MB scripts; top payloads are ad-tech and duplicate analytics resources.
findings.suggestedFix: Eliminate duplicate analytics, reduce vendors, and defer/batch background work.

findings.summary: Third-party script budget exceeds visible user value
findings.evidence: 20 of 21 observed origins are third party; large ad/analytics scripts dominate the 1.43MB transfer for a text-and-icon forecast.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a strict third-party budget and load optional advertising only after consent and idle.

findings.summary: DOM/heap footprint is excessive for a forecast page
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary contains 465,530 nodes and 26.26MB self size; the consent vendor UI contributes hundreds of headings and 755 links.
findings.suggestedFix: Render vendor detail on demand, virtualise long lists, and unload third-party consent/ad structures when closed.
